description: Insurance claims workflow gate: auto-approval only under declared authority, fresh documentation, and coverage; everything unsettled escalates instead of guessing.

rules.reason: Amount exceeds this adjuster's declared authority; route to named escalation.
Coverage determination excludes this claim category. This is a denial, not an unknown.

rules.when: fresh(coverage) and evidence.coverage == "covered" and present(docs_complete) and candidate.action.params.amount <= evidence.authority_limit
